Scene pack form is a basename-only glob `.godot/exported/*/export-*-<name>.scn`; two scenes with the same basename in different dirs would satisfy each other. Weak, not vacuous (P1 mutant: tscn claimed raw turns pack red while audit stays green).

publish-dev ordering of export-pack-check-strict after export-macos relies on make's prerequisite ordering across rule lines (Apple make 3.81 puts the recipe-carrying line first). Under GNU make 4.x it may run before export-macos; the outcome would be a loud strict failure on a clean tree, not a false green.
